subject: Discovery recap: migration off OpenAI/Anthropic -> open models
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ava Thompson <ava@finflow.ai>, Samir Rao <samir@finflow.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery recap: migration off OpenAI/Anthropic -> open models

Thanks for taking the time today — great conversation. Quick recap of what we heard and next steps so we're aligned:

Pain points / drivers:
- Cost volatility and rising per-token spend on current OpenAI usage (esp. streaming endpoints).
- Data residency / compliance concerns for certain EU users (need for regional hosting).
- Request for more predictable latency for autocomplete and chat flows (SLOs around 200ms p50).

Current stack (as discussed):
- Prod: OpenAI for chat + embeddings (davinci-like for chat, text-embedding-3-large for vectors).
- Some experiments with Anthropic for assistant flows.
- Batch embedding jobs run nightly into Pinecone; some real-time embed calls for search.
- Kubernetes-based API gateway with Terraform infra; GCP primary, some workloads in AWS.

Success criteria for migration project:
1) API compatibility with minimal client changes (support for OpenAI-compatible endpoints is high priority).
2) <=20% regression in perceived answer quality on key prompt set (we'll run evals).
3) Cost reduction target: 30%+ on per-token unit economics for high-volume routes.
4) Ability to host in EU region and support VPC/private deployment for PII-sensitive tenants.

Model shortlist (initial):
- Llama-3 70B (quantized variant) — good balance for chat quality.
- Mistral Instruct / Mistral 7B/13B for lower-cost routes.
- Llama-2 / Falcon variants for embedding compatibility tests.

Compatibility notes:
- You emphasized desire for an OpenAI-compatible API layer to avoid refactoring clients. Redwood offers an API translation layer + monitored fallbacks to keep your integration surface stable.
- We will run a small set of canonical prompts (you mentioned the 12 prompt families) to evaluate regressions.

Next steps (agreed):
1) Marissa/Rishi to send a short sandbox proposal and pricing term sheet (we'll include Dedicated vs. Hosted options) — by EOD 8/04.
2) FinFlow to share: current monthly token volumes (split by route), top 12 prompt families, and any regulatory constraints for EU-hosted tenants — by 8/06.
3) Schedule technical sandbox kickoff (30–45m) with your infra/ML engineer (Samir suggested Wed/Thu next week).
4) We'll include SOC2 report and example infrastructure diagram for private deployment.

Attachments included: SOC2_Audit_Report_Q1_2026.pdf, current_infra_diagram.png

Thanks again — happy to jump on another call if useful.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198

From: Ava Thompson <ava@finflow.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Rao <samir@finflow.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T16:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: migration off OpenAI/Anthropic -> open models

Thanks Marissa — this looks accurate, appreciate the clear summary. A couple clarifications from our side:

- Volumes: currently ~3.2B tokens/month across chat + embeddings; chat is ~70% of spend. We can provide per-route split by Friday.
- Quality: the 12 prompt families are ready — I'll upload them to the Docsend link you shared.
- Compliance: EU tenant data must remain within EU region; can consider VPC for enterprise customers.

We're interested in a sandbox that mirrors our production traffic patterns (esp. streaming latencies). Wed/Thu next week works for Samir and me for the technical kickoff.

Two asks: please include an estimate for cost delta for embeddings-only route (nightly batch -> offline embeddings) vs. real-time embeddings. Also share any known limitations with your OpenAI-compatible translation layer (rate limits / supported params).

I'll send the prompt families and per-route token breakout by EOD Friday (8/06).

Cheers,
Ava
Head of ML Ops | FinFlow
ava@finflow.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ava Thompson <ava@finflow.ai>, Samir Rao <samir@finflow.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-04T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: migration off OpenAI/Anthropic -> open models

Following up with the promised materials — attaching our pricing/term sheet and a short sandbox proposal. High level: Hosted sandbox for 4 weeks + optional Dedicated sandbox if you want to test VPC/EU hosting. Key items included in the term sheet: trial credits, expected throughput limits for trial, and a sample SLA for Dedicated.

Attachment: redwood_pricing_term_sheet.pdf

Regarding translation layer limitations:
- Supports OpenAI-compatible endpoints (chat.completions, responses, embeddings) and most common params (max_tokens, temperature, top_p, stop, streaming).
- Known gaps: provider-specific features like Anthropic-style safety filters or certain proprietary tool-calling integrations may require minor adapter code. We'll capture any gaps during the sandbox.

Action items for us:
- Rishi and I will set up the Hosted sandbox and provide test endpoints and credentials by 8/07.
- We'll propose two time slots for the tech kickoff: Wed 8/12 09:30–10:15 PT or Thu 8/13 11:00–11:45 PT.

If that looks good, we'll lock in the kickoff and Rishi will be on the call to walk through the runtime and evaluation harness.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Rishi — forwarding the thread. Key asks from FinFlow: production-like streaming latency test, embeddings cost delta, EU hosting/VPC for certain tenants.

Can you: 
- Review the sandbox plan and confirm we can provision a Hosted sandbox that simulates streaming at ~500 rps with their token mix?
- Recommend a quantized model variant from our shortlist that balances quality/cost for chat at scale (ideally something we can roll into Dedicated if the sandbox looks good).
- Suggest whether we should quote a concession/discount for the first 3 months to close the pilot (they're cost-sensitive).

I'll schedule the kickoff for 8/12 09:30 PT if you can join.

Thanks — Marissa
